grammar_title: 不定式 / 动名词 / 过去分词作表语(to do / doing / done as predicative)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修一 Unit 4 Using language:to-infinitive, -ing and -ed as predicative。句子地道、围绕艺术与灵感主题;干扰项均为错误的非谓语形式,正确答案唯一。

points.point: to do 作表语(主语为 wish/aim/plan/job 等,表示打算或目的)
points.overview: 主语是 wish/dream/aim/goal/plan/job/duty/task/hope/purpose 等表'意图、目标'的名词时,be 后用动词不定式作表语,说明'要做的事',如 Every artist's wish is to create something。

points.point: doing(-ing 形式)作表语(主语是引起感受的事物)
points.overview: 当主语是引起某种感受的事物、事件或作品时,be 后用 -ing 形式作表语,如 The film is amazing / The exhibition is exciting,意思是'令人……的'。

points.point: done(-ed 形式)作表语(主语是感受的承受者)+ -ing 与 -ed 对比
points.overview: 当主语是体会到某种感受的人(或处于某种状态)时,be/feel 后用 -ed 形式作表语,如 I am amazed / The window is broken;与 -ing 形成对比:事物用 -ing,人用 -ed。

questions.stem: Every artist's wish is ____ something that expresses an idea.
questions.explanation: 主语 wish 表意图,be 后用不定式说明'要做的事'→ to create。

questions.stem: My biggest dream has always been ____ a painting that moves people.
questions.explanation: 主语 dream 表目标,表语用不定式 → to paint。

questions.stem: Tan Dun's goal as a composer is ____ Chinese and Western sounds.
questions.explanation: 主语 goal 表目的,表语用不定式 → to combine。

questions.stem: The whole point of the show is ____ young artists to the public.
questions.explanation: 主语 point 表目的,表语用不定式 → to introduce。

questions.stem: Her plan for next year is ____ a series of folk paintings.
questions.explanation: plan + for next year 表将来打算,表语用不定式 → to produce。

questions.stem: The first step in painting is ____ the main idea clearly in your mind.
questions.explanation: 主语 step 表要做的步骤,表语用不定式 → to plan。

questions.stem: His aim is ____ the beauty of nature through his dance.
questions.explanation: 主语 aim 表目的,表语用不定式 → to show。

questions.stem: The artist's hope is ____ feelings that words cannot describe.
questions.explanation: 主语 hope 表愿望,表语用不定式 → to express。

questions.stem: Our task today is ____ an artwork that we really admire.
questions.explanation: 主语 task 表要完成的事,表语用不定式 → to describe。

questions.stem: The purpose of the audio guide is ____ the message of each painting.
questions.explanation: 主语 purpose 表目的,表语用不定式 → to explain。

questions.stem: Yang Liping's wish was ____ the special beauty of the Dai women.
questions.explanation: 主语 wish 表意图,表语用不定式 → to celebrate。

questions.stem: The next step for the museum is ____ the old scroll in a digital form.
questions.explanation: 主语 step 表要做的步骤,表语用不定式 → to present。

questions.stem: An artist's first job is ____ the world around them with fresh eyes.
questions.explanation: 主语 job 表职责,表语用不定式 → to notice。

questions.stem: The main goal of the festival is ____ new art forms with the public.
questions.explanation: 主语 goal 表目的,表语用不定式 → to share。

questions.stem: His real challenge was ____ light and shadow in a single image.
questions.explanation: 主语 challenge 表要克服的任务,表语用不定式 → to capture。

questions.stem: The duty of a good art teacher is ____ each student's creative side.
questions.explanation: 主语 duty 表职责,表语用不定式 → to inspire。

questions.stem: My only wish before the show closes is ____ the famous painting in person.
questions.explanation: 主语 wish 表愿望,表语用不定式 → to see。

questions.stem: Hofman's idea was ____ a giant duck that everyone would love.
questions.explanation: 主语 idea 表打算做的事,表语用不定式 → to design。

questions.stem: The aim of the project was ____ data in the way an artist uses paint.
questions.explanation: 主语 aim 表目的,表语用不定式 → to use。

questions.stem: A sculptor's task is often ____ a living shape out of cold stone.
questions.explanation: 主语 task 表要完成的事,表语用不定式 → to build。

questions.stem: The new exhibition on abstract art is really ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 exhibition 是引起感受的事物,表语用 -ing → amazing。

questions.stem: Her performance on stage was so ____ that nobody moved.
questions.explanation: 主语 performance 引起感动,表语用 -ing → moving。

questions.stem: The story behind the painting is quite ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 story 是引起兴趣的事物,表语用 -ing → fascinating。

questions.stem: Tan Dun's music for the film is truly ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 music 给人启发,表语用 -ing → inspiring。

questions.stem: The light show at night is absolutely ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 light show 是令人惊叹的事物,表语用 -ing → astonishing。

questions.stem: For me, the long lecture on folk art was rather ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 lecture 是令人乏味的事物,表语用 -ing → boring。

questions.stem: The colours in this artwork are very ____ to the eye.
questions.explanation: 主语 colours 是令人愉悦的事物,表语用 -ing → pleasing。

questions.stem: The sudden change of scene in the play was ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 change 是令人意外的事,表语用 -ing → surprising。

questions.stem: Walking around the huge museum all day can be ____.
questions.explanation: 主语(walking 这件事)使人疲惫,表语用 -ing → tiring。

questions.stem: The way the artist mixes ideas is a little ____ at first.
questions.explanation: 主语 way 是令人困惑的事物,表语用 -ing → confusing。

questions.stem: The final result of the project was deeply ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 result 令人满意,表语用 -ing → satisfying。

questions.stem: The price of some of the tickets is honestly ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 price 令人震惊,表语用 -ing → shocking。

questions.stem: Soft music playing in the gallery is quite ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 music 使人放松,表语用 -ing → relaxing。

questions.stem: The film about the young painter is very ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 film 令人感动,表语用 -ing → touching。

questions.stem: Sadly, the ending of the show was a bit ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 ending 令人失望,表语用 -ing → disappointing。

questions.stem: Some of the dark sculptures in the hall look ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 sculptures 是令人害怕的事物,表语用 -ing → frightening。

questions.stem: Her kind words about my drawing were really ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 words 给人鼓舞,表语用 -ing → encouraging。

questions.stem: The idea of painting with data is rather ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 idea 令人兴奋,表语用 -ing → exciting。

questions.stem: The view from the top of the giant sculpture is ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 view 令人惊艳,表语用 -ing → stunning。

questions.stem: This abstract painting is far more ____ than I expected.
questions.explanation: 主语 painting 是引起兴趣的事物,表语用 -ing → interesting。

questions.stem: I am totally ____ by the painting called Storm.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 是感受的承受者,表语用 -ed → amazed。

questions.stem: The visitors were deeply ____ by the young artist's story.
questions.explanation: 主语 visitors 是被感动的人,表语用 -ed → moved。

questions.stem: After the visit, she was really ____ in abstract art.
questions.explanation: 主语 she 体会到兴趣,表语用 -ed → interested。

questions.stem: After the long tour, the children were quite ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 children 感到疲惫,表语用 -ed → tired。

questions.stem: Richard was honestly ____ by the over-priced tickets.
questions.explanation: 主语 Richard 受到震惊,表语用 -ed → shocked。

questions.stem: Everyone in the hall was ____ by the breathtaking installation.
questions.explanation: 主语 everyone 被吸引,表语用 -ed → fascinated。

questions.stem: The teacher was very ____ with the students' creative work.
questions.explanation: 主语 teacher 感到满意,表语用 -ed → pleased。

questions.stem: At first I felt a bit ____ by the strange shapes.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 感到困惑,feel 后用 -ed → confused。

questions.stem: We were all ____ by the beauty of the digital scroll.
questions.explanation: 主语 we 留下深刻印象,表语用 -ed → impressed。

questions.stem: The audience seemed ____ during the slow parts of the film.
questions.explanation: 主语 audience 感到无聊,表语用 -ed → bored。

questions.stem: Amy was so ____ about the new exhibition that she told all her friends.
questions.explanation: 主语 Amy 感到兴奋,表语用 -ed → excited。

questions.stem: He was honestly ____ when his work was chosen for the show.
questions.explanation: 主语 he 感到惊讶,表语用 -ed → astonished。

questions.stem: The crowd was ____ to learn that a computer had made the painting.
questions.explanation: 主语 crowd 感到意外,表语用 -ed → surprised。

questions.stem: The girl looked ____ by the kind comments on her drawing.
questions.explanation: 主语 girl 被打动,表语用 -ed → touched。

questions.stem: Some teachers are ____ that computers may one day create art.
questions.explanation: 主语 teachers 感到担忧,表语用 -ed → worried。

questions.stem: The students were warmly ____ by their teacher to keep trying.
questions.explanation: 主语 students 受到鼓励,表语用 -ed → encouraged。

questions.stem: Sadly, the fans were ____ when the show was cancelled.
questions.explanation: 主语 fans 感到失望,表语用 -ed → disappointed。

questions.stem: Standing alone in the dark gallery, the boy felt ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 boy 感到害怕,feel 后用 -ed → frightened。

questions.stem: After finishing the huge mural, the painter felt deeply ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 painter 感到满足,feel 后用 -ed → satisfied。

questions.stem: We were truly ____ by the artist's passion for his motherland.
questions.explanation: 主语 we 受到鼓舞,表语用 -ed → inspired。
